events.label: Under Tenairah’s Smoke
events.description: The Door opens onto a dead plain beneath a ceiling of black smoke. No direct sunlight reaches the road, though the hour should be day. Far away, ruined towers rise from red grass.

events.label: The First Living Voice
events.description: A terrified scavenger emerges from beneath a collapsed grain cellar, one of the vanishingly few living humans still hiding in Tenairah’s kingdom.

events.label: Levy at the Broken Mile
events.description: A patrol of pale soldiers and vampire levy troops notices fresh blood on the road.
